findings.one_line: The proposal promised recovery of one refinement-minimal atomic partition, but the headline now only gives a DAG conditional on each admissible partition and expressly leaves its domain non-singleton; restore a partition-recovery theorem or reframe the contribution around a substantively new, explicitly limited frontier.

The claimed ExactID functional is an implicit fiber over arbitrary C3 mechanisms and innovations, not an evaluable recovery map from P: give a finite-dimensional/algorithmic membership and graph-recovery procedure, or state the result solely as an abstract compatibility relation rather than an identification deliverable.
